Variation A — Cluster
Closest to today's Day screen. Core dominates by size; Recovery and Sleep read as supporting satellites.
Tradeoff: uses the most vertical space.

Variation B — Concentric dial
One compact instrument, Core on the outer ring. Premium and space-efficient.
Tradeoff: arcs are harder to compare at a glance; leans on the legend.

Variation C — Linear tracks
Most minimal and most legible for exact values; scales to more metrics later.
Tradeoff: loses the iconic ring identity.

Style 1 — Equal row
All three circles the same size, evenly placed. Calm and symmetric; good for Body overview.
Tradeoff: no visual hierarchy — Core is not emphasised.

Style 2 — Stacked list
Small circle + label per row, left-aligned. The most compact placement; fits alongside other content.
Tradeoff: circles are small, less of a hero moment.

Style 3 — Triad
Core larger, top-centre; Recovery and Sleep below. Gradient tapered arcs add depth.
Tradeoff: gradient is slightly less flat/minimal than solid arcs.
